body:
[README.md](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/README.md) section contains "We are also actively looking for translations of the 4.n branch." but does not give any hints or guidelines, what to do for adding new translation.

Recommendation: add section for "translation" to [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and link to that to README.md

Some points to cover:

  * what version to translate
  * what to do in github for that
  * translate .md files (not push docx or pdf)


Related opened issues:

  * #1033
  * #875
  * #805

Related pull-request:

  * https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/911

comments.body: Created  PR #1037, @elarlang  please review and comment

In short - if someone want to translate some **released version** of ASVS, he/she need to have ready "git magic" list of commands for creating correct branch and folder structure etc - so, we need to provide it.

Additionally, some rules and guidelines for translations, like entire document structure must stay the same for export solutions (like Makefile).
Elar can you take a swing at making https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/1037/files more complete, please?

title: Add a HOWTO guide for translations
